item.tib: stag la phung 'bar nag po'i zlog pa'i spyan 'dren
item.coloph: bdag 'dra phung bon mgo dmar gyis/ phyi rabs bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag khod spungs dran pa bdag gis kyang / pom ra'i gnas su gter du sbas/ bon gyi bstan pa 'dzin par shog dun rtse nang dme byed par shog u ya/ ag tham/ rgya rgya rgya//
